releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.4 — the inert rows are alive. Status is now a real story viewer: tap any update for the full-screen view with segmented progress bars, tap-left/tap-right navigation, auto-advance and the brand backdrops; updates you have watched turn grey in the list. Tapping a chat's avatar or name opens the Profile page — gradient title bar, ringed 96dp avatar, @handle, presence line, About card, Message/Call/Video actions and a Block menu. Groups can finally be created: the + button opens the New Group screen (name, description, member picker with gradient selection circles), the group lands at the top of the list, and tapping a group opens its conversation.
